200|"And HaShem placed His Name upon them," for there is a Name
201|of the Holy One, blessed be He, that has 42
202|letters. There is such a thing. There is a Name of 70 letters,
203|72 letters, 42 letters. There are other Names too.
204|I'll tell you just one thing, without going into detail now. You
205|know the hymn Ana BeKoach? Yes.
206|So, Ana BeKoach, "gedulat yeminekha": it has 42 words,
207|and the first letter of each one of them is one
208|of the letters
209|that make up the Name of 42
210|letters. Okay? So now the Name of HaShem is found within
211|this number, 42, and therefore the journey had to
212|include 42 stages,
213|corresponding to the letters in the Name of HaShem.
214|"And HaShem placed His Name upon them" hints that it brought them from distress to relief.
215|That is, our way of coming out of the many troubles
216|is the letters of the Name of HaShem.
217|Therefore each one of the stations of "and they encamped"
218|is in fact a state of coming out of a certain hardship in the
219|long journey at whose end we arrive in the Land of Israel,
220|which brought them out of distress to relief, even though many evils passed over them
221|and troubles, and they went from evil to evil, He did not destroy them.
222|That is, we went through so many hard things that any
223|ordinary nation would long ago have surrendered to them and vanished,
224|and we survive, Am Yisrael Chai, and the great miracle of
225|Am Yisrael Chai is because of the 42
226|letters of the Name of HaShem.
227|Even though many evils and troubles passed over us
228|and we went from evil to evil, He did not destroy them, through the secret of
229|the Name hinted at in these journeys. And this is
230|to assure us that HaShem will do so in the future Redemption.
231|Listen well, friends:
232|even though we will wander and drift
233|from mountain to hill, and from kingdom to kingdom,
234|and from expulsion to expulsion,
235|he lived right after the expulsion from Spain,
236|the Tzror HaMor: from the Land of Israel to the diaspora, and from France
237|to Spain,
238|and from Spain to the kingdom of Ishmael, and may He answer us…
239|and may He who dwells of old, Selah, protect us.
